status: NEW (realistic adult OPM vs Neuromag comparison, MNE sample subject)

background.calibration: median over good gradiometers of (baseline - empty room) variance in the band

environment.fit: empty-room recording of the sample dataset, weighted least squares, bad channels left out

notes: Bootstrap CIs resample cortical target locations of one anatomy; they do not include model or between-subject uncertainty, which the sensitivity analyses bound.
Head-position variants move the head in the fixed Neuromag helmet; the room field is kept in head coordinates (8-term model; the change over a 5-mm move is second order).
Detectability is a known-topography matched-filter SNR, not an event detection rate or localization accuracy.
